LG/SM F3 intercross: phenotypes

Source: R/data.R
lgsm_f3.Rd

Phenotypes of 1611 mice from the F3 generation of an intercross of the LG/J and SM/J inbred strains, with their pedigree and rearing. The traits fall in four classes, listed in lgsm_traits: growth (weekly weight gains), weight (the raw weekly body weights), area (mandible areas) and necropsy (organ and fat pad weights). Genotypes are in lgsm_genotypes, the markers in lgsm_markers, and the relationship matrix in lgsm_A.

Usage

lgsm_f3

Format

A data frame with one row per mouse, in this column order:

ID

mouse identifier; matches the row names of the lgsm_genotypes matrices and of lgsm_A (as character).

FAMILY

full-sib family.

Sire

father (an F2 mouse, genotyped in lgsm_genotypes); four missing in the source were inferred from the markers, see sire_inferred.

Dam

mother (an F2 mouse).

NURSE

the dam that reared the mouse (pups were cross-fostered, see xfostpair).

SEX

"F" or "M".

LSB

litter size at birth.

LSW

litter size at weaning.

COHORT

rearing cohort.

xfostpair

cross-fostering indicator, as in the source.

growth12

weight gain from week 1 to week 2, WEEK2 - WEEK1 (growth).

growth23

weight gain from week 2 to week 3, WEEK3 - WEEK2 (growth).

growth34

weight gain from week 3 to week 4, WEEK4 - WEEK3 (growth).

growth45

weight gain from week 4 to week 5, WEEK5 - WEEK4 (growth).

growth56

weight gain from week 5 to week 6, WEEK6 - WEEK5 (growth).

growth67

weight gain from week 6 to week 7, WEEK7 - WEEK6 (growth).

growth78

weight gain from week 7 to week 8, WEEK8 - WEEK7 (growth).

growth89

weight gain from week 8 to week 9, WEEK9 - WEEK8 (growth).

growth910

weight gain from week 9 to week 10, WEEK10 - WEEK9 (growth).

WEEK1

body weight at week 1 (weight).

WEEK2

body weight at week 2 (weight).

WEEK3

body weight at week 3 (weight).

WEEK4

body weight at week 4 (weight).

WEEK5

body weight at week 5 (weight).

WEEK6

body weight at week 6 (weight).

WEEK7

body weight at week 7 (weight).

WEEK8

body weight at week 8 (weight).

WEEK9

body weight at week 9 (weight).

WEEK10

body weight at week 10 (weight).

FATPAD

fat pad weight at necropsy (necropsy); a few missing.

HEART

heart weight at necropsy (necropsy); a few missing.

KIDNEY

kidney weight at necropsy (necropsy); a few missing.

SPLEEN

spleen weight at necropsy (necropsy); a few missing.

LIVER

liver weight at necropsy (necropsy); a few missing.

area1

mandible area 1 (area); NA for the 95 mice without areas.

area2

mandible area 2 (area); NA for the 95 mice without areas.

area3

mandible area 3 (area); NA for the 95 mice without areas.

area4

mandible area 4 (area); NA for the 95 mice without areas.

area5

mandible area 5 (area); NA for the 95 mice without areas.

area6

mandible area 6 (area); NA for the 95 mice without areas.

area7

mandible area 7 (area); NA for the 95 mice without areas.

sire_inferred

TRUE for the four mice whose sire is missing in the source and was found by Mendelian exclusion: 1133, 1139 and 1140 (family 199, dam 135) are sired by 165, and 1109 (dam 207) by 229. Each inferred sire is consistent with the offspring and dam at every marker; the next best candidate fails at 12 or more (on mice with a recorded sire, the recorded one always had none and the next best 12 or more).

Values are as in the source files, apart from the gains computed from them: no transformation, no correction for the rearing covariates.

Source

Melo, D., Marroig, G. and Wolf, J. B. (2019). Genomic perspective on multivariate variation, pleiotropy, and evolution. Journal of Heredity 110, 479-493. doi:10.1093/jhered/esz011 . Built by data-raw/lgsm.R from that study's analysis files.

Details

The cross: the parental (P) strains are fully inbred, the F1 are all heterozygous, and the F2 parents of these F3 mice are unrelated. The F2 are the founders of the pedigree (lgsm_pedigree).
